revisions.author: FID Rayhan
revisions.description: Source = TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE_STG_SYNC only; parts of the run by GTOPAS_SYNC_STATUS 0 + PERIOD ([Sync] Current, Period Rollover new period), no date condition (22-Nov).

objective: To make the GTOPAS Crossdock Master (WVJA5204, Depot 01) equal to NSP by an RPA, per part of the run: destination in NSP and not in GTOPAS -> Add; in both -> Keep; in GTOPAS and not in NSP -> Delete.
Source data: only TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE_STG_SYNC (read-only DB user), parts of the run ID: [Sync] (Current period) or the Period Rollover (new Current period, started by XD05 process 3).
GTOPAS has no period: it always shows the Current month, so the Next period is sent only at the Period Rollover.
The bot writes nothing back to NSP; the result comes by the notification e-mail.

steps: NSP starts the flow with the run ID: after [Sync] (rows of the Current period) or after the Period Rollover (XD05 process 3, rows of the new Current period). The staging is already updated (GTOPAS_SYNC_STATUS 1). Write LOG1. The whole run is inside one try-catch.

steps.text: Read TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE_STG_SYNC (read-only DB user): parts = distinct PART_NO + PERIOD with GTOPAS_SYNC_RUN_ID = run ID.
children: NSP destinations of a part: latest EXPORT row (largest HIST_ID, CREATED_DT <= GTOPAS_SYNC_DT) per destination + order type of the part + period with NEW_VALUE >= 1; order types together (one GTOPAS row per P/No. + Destination Code).

steps: Search the parts on WVJA5204 (Depot 01) and read their rows.

steps.text: Compare per P/No. (without "-") + Destination Code and fill the work sheet GTOPAS Compare:
children: In NSP only: Add (Depot 01, Maker A, Dom/Os 2, TOPAS Order Type *, Trans 2). In GTOPAS only: Delete. In both: Keep (nothing).

steps: Any error (try-catch): stop, write LOG4; rows done before the error stay. [Re-send last Sync] or the next run compares again.
Send the notification e-mail (SUCCESS / FAILED), write LOG6 and LOG2. The bot writes nothing to NSP.

items: Every value change of the Kanban / Export Crossdock Master is a row of TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE_STG_SYNC (refer XD01 5.24). GTOPAS_SYNC_STATUS 0 only for an EXPORT ADD / DELETE (a destination appears or disappears); quantities are not sent to GTOPAS.
[Sync]: the GTOPAS rows of the Current period (GTOPAS_SYNC_STATUS 0 + PERIOD = Current, no date) are set to 1 and this bot starts. The rows of the Next period wait.

Period Rollover (XD05 process 3, day 1 00:10): the rows of the new Current period with GTOPAS_SYNC_STATUS 0 are set to 1 and this bot starts. XD05 writes EXPORT rows for every destination of the new period, so every part of the period is compared.

items: Compare key: P/No. (without "-") + Destination Code; the order types of a destination are one GTOPAS row.
NSP destinations = latest staging value >= 1 of the part + period of the run; only the parts of the run are compared.

Why the rollover: WVJA5204 has no period. Sending the Next period on day D would change GTOPAS for the month still running; AP POLE has an Effective Month, so it gets the Next period earlier by [Sync].
The whole run is in one try-catch; any error stops the run (LOG4). Rows added / deleted before the error stay in GTOPAS.
NSP does not receive the result; the staging stays Sync. [Re-send last Sync] (or the next run) compares again and completes the rest.
The cloud flow of the RPA sends one email per run of XD06 (GTOPAS), so the user knows the result without opening NSP.
One email per target: XD06 (GTOPAS) and XD07 (AP POLE) run as separate bots, so a [Sync] gives two emails.
One email per run: the retries of the same run do not send an email; only the final result does.

tables.name: TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE_STG_SYNC
tables.description: Staging of every value change of the Kanban / Export Crossdock Master for the sync to AP POLE (XD07) and GTOPAS (XD06) (22-Nov). Inserted by XD01 (screen), XD02 / XD03 (upload) and XD05 in the same transaction as the master update; updated only by [Sync], [Re-send last Sync] and the Period Rollover. The RPA reads only this table. TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE (screen history) is kept as it is.
columns: Running number (identity): order of the changes
Part number (NSP format, with "-"); FK1 (PART_NO, PERIOD) -> TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE
Part Name copied from TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE at the insert (Part Name of the Kanban upload file)
Calculation period YYYYMM; Effective Month / Year of the AP POLE upload
Status of the part in this period when the row is written (Active / Inactive). Inactive: the part stays in the AP POLE Kanban, its Export rows are DELETE with NEW_VALUE 0
KANBAN = parent (Kanban Crossdock Master), EXPORT = destination (Export Crossdock Master)
EXPORT only: destination code. No FK (a DELETE row points to a removed destination)
Value before the change; NULL on ADD
Value after the change; 0 on DELETE
Upload of the Kanban or Export Excel (Log); NULL when SOURCE is not UPLOAD
0 = Non Sync (default), 1 = Sync, 2 = Superseded (an earlier row of the same key, not sent). The part + period is AP POLE Non Sync while it has a row with 0
Time of the [Sync] that sent the row to AP POLE (status 1 and 2); Last Sent AP POLE = latest value

Upload file: 1 = Export (LLM9Q880) before the Kanban file, only for a part whose Max goes down; 2 = Kanban (LLM9Q910); 3 = Export after the Kanban file (every other part). Set at [Sync] on the last row of each key; NULL for 2 and for a key that ends on its first value
AP POLE run ID YYYYMMDDHHMMSS; [Re-send last Sync] takes the rows of the last run
NULL = not for GTOPAS (KANBAN rows, EXPORT EDIT). 0 = Non Sync: EXPORT ADD / DELETE (destination appears / disappears). 1 = Sync: [Sync] for the Current period, the Period Rollover for the new period
Time of the [Sync] / Period Rollover that sent the row to GTOPAS; Last Sent GTOPAS = latest value
GTOPAS run ID ([Sync], [Re-send last Sync] or the Period Rollover)
User of the save / upload, or XD05BATCH
Time of the insert (same transaction as the master update)
User of [Sync] / [Re-send last Sync], XD05BATCH for the Period Rollover
